title: Can You Time Value Stocks?
text: So the next question, can we time value? And value is interesting because they're cheaper relative to growth in like 87% of years since 1926. So higher means cheap stocks are unusually cheap compared to the expensive one. And it's near the top of the range today, which is literally the 87th percentile. So then the question is, is value due? Is that a thing? Is it time for it to pay out? And one of the things is a widespread pointed the right way, but a little bit too weak. It's at 1.6 T stat. So again, from a trader lens, I definitely would lean towards yes, but not with an insane amount of conviction. It explains about 6% of the year-to-year swings.
